newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu ponders new wholesale pricing system.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu ponders new wholesale pricing system.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd announced on Wednesday it has started to review the wholesale pricing system it introduced last year after the industry was deregulated on April 1.

Company president Yuji Idemitsu told a news conference that the company had not yet decided whether it would change its current pricing system, which takes into account foreign exchange movements and crude oil prices.
"We might eventually decide to maintain the system. We don't know yet," Idemitsu said.
Leading Japanese refiners including Idemitsu all revamped their monthly wholesale pricing systems last year to better reflect international markets.

The company had said that it was prompted to consider possible changes because kerosene and gas oil prices are currently slightly more expensive than gasoline on overseas markets, but that the price difference was not properly reflected under the current pricing system.
Moreover, it said that distribution costs differ between various areas, and that this was not mirrored in the current pricing system.
